For this project, I am looking for a developer to create three inter-related scripts than can be run independently. Script 1 will combine and manipulate data from two .xlsx files:

- Input1.xlsx
- Input2.xlsx

Script 2 and 3 will then take different sets of input data and append certain aspects to the input1.xlsx file.

Detailed Project Requirements

Script1:

Open the input1.xlsx file attached to this post. The input1.xlsx file has 21 columns. Column I contains emails.

Now, open the input2.xlsx file attached to this post. This file has 3 columns. Column B contains emails.

For all emails in input2.xlsx column B, if the email can be found in input1.xlsx Column I, copy the adjacent value from input2.xlsx column C into the adjacent cell in input1.xlsx column N.

In input1.xlsx, create a new sheet called “DOMAINS&MESSAGES” and copy all values from column E, G and N from the MASTERSHEET tab into columns A, B and C respectively in the DOMAINS&MESSAGES tab, naming the columns “companyName”, “emailDomain” and “bounceMessage” respectively. 

In DOMAINS&MESSAGES, de-duplicate the table rows based on email addresses.

In DOMAINS&MESSAGES, for all cells in column A, that do not have a value in the adjacent column C cell, populate the adjacent column C cell with the value “delivered”.
In DOMAINS&MESSAGES, Create a duplicate of column C and place it to the right in column D, and name it “shortBounceMessage”.

In DOMAINS&MESSAGES, for all cells in column D, delete all characters after the first “]” value in the cell, to trim all messages in column C down to [Hard], [Internal] or [Soft] without any remaining text. 

Now, create a new tab in the file called “SUMMARY”. And create a table that displays data from DOMAINS&MESSAGES in the following columns:

A. Each unique company name.
B. Each unique domain.
C. Total number of [Hard] messages.
D. Total number of [Internal] messages.
E. Total number of [Soft] messages.
F. Total number of Delivered values.
G. Total number of [Hard], [Internal] and [Soft] messages.
H. Total number of Delivered values, [Hard], [Internal] and [Soft] messages.
I. Total number of Delivered values divided by the (sum of all Delivered values, [Hard], [Internal] and [Soft] messages).

And name the columns as such as seen in the input1.xlsx file:

A. CompanyName
B. Domain
C. [Hard]
D. [Internal]
E. [Soft]
F. Total Delivered
G. Total Bounced
H. Total Attempted
I. EmailDeliverySuccess%

Finally, insert a new column to the right of column A, and title this column as “Registrations”, and assign a value of 0 to all cells in the table.

Script 1 is now complete.

Script2:

Open input3.xlsx, this file contains 3 columns. These columns are titled with a unique name, and each column contains a list of company names.

For each column in input3.xlsx, append a new column to the right of column I in the input1.xlsx file SUMMARY tab.

For each column in input3.xlsx, for each company name in the column, if the name is found in column A in the input1.xlsx file SUMMARY tab, place an “x” in the new column that was added respectively for the input3.xlsx column.

If the company name is not found in column A in the input1.xlsx file SUMMARY tab, append the company name to the bottom of column A in the input1.xlsx file SUMMARY tab.

Script 2 is now complete.

Script3:

Open input4.xlsx, this file contains a list of company names. For each company name in column A, if the company name is also found in column A in the input1.xlsx file SUMMARY tab, increment the value in the “registrations” column by 1.
